name: HCP Event Management
one_liner: Advisory boards, CMEs and congresses with invitations, attendance and transparency reporting.
fits_when: the company runs advisory boards, CMEs, round tables or congress sponsorships with HCPs
compliance must approve the agenda, venue and budget per HCP before invitations go out
HCPs are invited, RSVP and state travel or stay needs, ideally in their own login
attendance has to be captured per session with evidence such as QR scans or sign-in sheets
every transfer of value must be tied to a recipient HCP and reported for UCPMP, EFPIA or Sunshine-style disclosure
gives_you: Event lifecycle from draft through compliance review, invitations, completion and spend sign-off
HCP master with registration-number duplicate checks, verification and an annual transfer-of-value cap
Invitations with RSVP by the HCP, travel and stay needs, and roles such as speaker, chair or panelist
Attendance per session by QR, sign-in sheet or virtual log, verified by compliance
Spend ledger by category with invoices, verified per event and reported per HCP
Event 360 page with invitations, attendance, spend and an activity timeline

catalogue.description: An HCP event app for advisory boards, CMEs and congresses: event managers plan events and invite HCPs, compliance approves agendas and budgets, HCPs RSVP in their own login, attendance is captured per session, and every rupee of spend is verified and reported per HCP for transparency. The spec is previewed live as a clickable app with demo data while the requirement is shaped.

roles.name: Event manager
roles.description: Plans events, invites HCPs, captures attendance and records spend

roles.name: HCP
roles.description: External login that answers invitations and sees only their own events and transfers of value

roles.name: Compliance reviewer
roles.description: Approves events, verifies HCPs, attendance and spend, and signs off spend reporting

workflows.name: Event planning
workflows.description: Draft, compliance review against agenda and per-HCP budget policy, approve or send back

workflows.name: Invitations & RSVP
workflows.description: Invite verified HCPs, send when invitations open, accept or decline with travel and stay needs

workflows.name: Attendance capture
workflows.description: Record attendance per session by QR, sign-in sheet or virtual log, verified by compliance

workflows.name: Spend reporting
workflows.description: Spend lines with invoices verified per event, signed off and reported per recipient HCP

compliance: No invitations before compliance approves the agenda, venue and budget per HCP
Honoraria only for speakers, chairs and panelists, never for delegates
Attendance evidence for every HCP who receives a transfer of value
Spend transparency: every transfer of value tied to a recipient HCP and an invoice, reported under UCPMP / EFPIA
Audit trail of every approval, RSVP, attendance and spend change
catalogue.app_prompt_prefill: HCP event app for our oncology franchise: event managers plan advisory boards, regional CMEs and congress sponsorships, and compliance approves each agenda, venue and budget per HCP before invitations go out. Verified HCPs RSVP in their own login with travel and stay needs, and attendance is captured per session by QR scan. Advisory board honoraria are paid only after the panelist's written output is accepted. Every spend line is verified against an invoice and reported per HCP each quarter, with a compliance reviewer preparing and the compliance head signing off.

changelog: First version: event planning with compliance approval, invitations with HCP RSVP, per-session attendance, and a verified spend ledger reported per HCP on the Zango app spec v1.
